CakePHP 2.8

Complete Console Shell Reference & Concept Guide v2.8.0 PHP 5.4â€“7.4 Released Feb 2016

Legacy Notice: This guide covers CakePHP 2.8.0 (2016). For modern CakePHP, use the CakePHP 5.4 guide. Key differences: CLI uses Console/cake (not bin/cake), app code lives in app/ folder, controllers/models use old conventions (AppController, $uses, find()).

Installation

# Via Composer (for older PHP)
composer create-project cakephp/cakephp:2.8.0 myapp

# Or download from https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/releases/tag/2.8.0

# Directory structure after install:
myapp/
  app/
    Config/
    Console/
    Controller/
    Lib/
    Locale/
    Model/
    Plugin/
    Test/
    tmp/
    Vendor/
    View/
    webroot/
  lib/
    Cake/
  vendors/
  .htaccess
  index.php

# Run the console:
cd myapp/app
Console/cake

# Start dev server (PHP 5.4+ built-in):
Console/cake server

Console Shells Reference

CakePHP 2.8 shells are invoked via Console/cake <shell> from the app/ directory. Each shell may have subcommands.

Built-in Core Shells

Shell / CommandDescription
cakeList all available shells
cake bakeInteractive code generator (models, controllers, views)
cake bake allBake all MVC for every table
cake bake model <name>Generate a model file
cake bake controller <name>Generate a controller
cake bake view <name>Generate view templates
cake bake project <name>Create a new CakePHP project
cake bake plugin <name>Create a plugin skeleton
cake bake fixture <name>Generate a test fixture
cake bake test <type> <name>Generate a test case
cake aclManage ACL (create ARO/ACO, grant/deny)
cake acl create aco rootCreate root ACO node
cake acl grant <aro> <aco>Grant permission
cake acl deny <aro> <aco>Deny permission
cake acl check <aro> <aco>Check permission
cake i18nExtract i18n .pot file from source
cake i18n --no-locationsExtract without location references (2.8+)
cake schemaSchema management (generate/compare/create)
cake schema generateGenerate schema file from database
cake schema createCreate tables from schema file
cake serverStart PHP built-in development server
cake testsuiteRun test suite
cake completionAuto-completion (bash/zsh)
cake command_listList all available commands
cake upgradeUpgrade application from 2.7 to 2.8
cake apiGenerate API docs

Bake Commands (Detailed)

Bake is interactive in 2.x. Use cake bake to enter the interactive menu, or pass arguments directly.

# Bake everything for all tables
Console/cake bake all

# Bake a single model
Console/cake bake model Article
# Prompts: connection, interactively set validation, associations

# Bake all models
Console/cake bake model all

# Bake a controller
Console/cake bake controller Articles
# Generates: app/Controller/ArticlesController.php

# Bake all controllers
Console/cake bake controller all

# Bake views for a controller
Console/cake bake view Articles
# Generates: app/View/Articles/index.ctp, add.ctp, edit.ctp, etc.

# Bake all views
Console/cake bake view all

# Bake a plugin skeleton
Console/cake bake plugin MyPlugin

# Bake a fixture for testing
Console/cake bake fixture Article

# Bake a test case
Console/cake bake test model Article
Console/cake bake test controller Articles

# Bake a project skeleton
Console/cake bake project /path/to/newapp

# With database connection specified
Console/cake bake -connection default

Routing

Define routes in app/Config/routes.php using static calls to Router.

app/Config/routes.php
// Default routing
Router::connect('/', array('controller' => 'pages', 'action' => 'display', 'home'));

// Named parameters
Router::connect(
    '/blog/:slug',
    array('controller' => 'articles', 'action' => 'view'),
    array('pass' => array('slug'), 'slug' => '[a-z0-9-]+')
);

// Prefix routing (e.g., /admin/articles)
Configure::write('Routing.prefixes', array('admin', 'manager'));
Router::connect(
    '/admin/:controller/:action/*',
    array('prefix' => 'admin', 'admin' => true)
);

// Plugin routes
Router::connect(
    '/my-plugin/:controller/:action/*',
    array('plugin' => 'my_plugin')
);

// Custom route classes (2.8+)
Router::connect('/api/:controller/:action/*', array(
    'routeClass' => 'ApiRoute'
));

// Reverse routing (generate URLs)
$url = Router::url(array(
    'controller' => 'articles',
    'action' => 'view',
    'slug' => 'hello-world'
));

// Load plugin routes
CakePlugin::routes();

Controllers

ArticlesController.php — CRUD
// app/Controller/ArticlesController.php
class ArticlesController extends AppController
{
    public $name = 'Articles';
    public $uses = array('Article');
    public $components = array('Paginator', 'Session', 'Auth');
    public $helpers = array('Html', 'Form', 'Session', 'Time');

    public function beforeFilter()
    {
        parent::beforeFilter();
        $this->Auth->allow('index', 'view');
    }

    public function index()
    {
        $this->Paginator->settings = array(
            'contain' => array('Author'),
            'limit' => 20,
            'order' => array('Article.created' => 'desc'),
        );
        $articles = $this->Paginator->paginate('Article');
        $this->set(compact('articles'));
    }

    public function view($id = null)
    {
        $this->Article->id = $id;
        if (!$this->Article->exists()) {
            throw new NotFoundException(__('Invalid article'));
        }
        $this->Article->contain('Author', 'Tag');
        $article = $this->Article->read();
        $this->set(compact('article'));
    }

    public function add()
    {
        if ($this->request->is('post')) {
            $this->Article->create();
            if ($this->Article->save($this->request->data)) {
                $this->Session->setFlash('Article saved.');
                return $this->redirect(array('action' => 'index'));
            }
            $this->Session->setFlash('Unable to save.');
        }
    }

    public function edit($id = null)
    {
        $this->Article->id = $id;
        if (!$this->Article->exists()) {
            throw new NotFoundException(__('Invalid article'));
        }
        if ($this->request->is('post') || $this->request->is('put')) {
            if ($this->Article->save($this->request->data)) {
                $this->Session->setFlash('Article updated.');
                return $this->redirect(array('action' => 'index'));
            }
            $this->Session->setFlash('Unable to update.');
        }
        $this->request->data = $this->Article->read();
    }

    public function delete($id = null)
    {
        $this->Article->id = $id;
        if (!$this->Article->exists()) {
            throw new NotFoundException(__('Invalid article'));
        }
        if ($this->Article->delete()) {
            $this->Session->setFlash('Article deleted.');
        }
        return $this->redirect(array('action' => 'index'));
    }
}

Models & ORM

Article.php — Model
// app/Model/Article.php
class Article extends AppModel
{
    public $name = 'Article';
    public $useTable = 'articles';
    public $primaryKey = 'id';

    public $belongsTo = array('Author');
    public $hasMany = array('Comment');
    public $hasAndBelongsToMany = array('Tag');

    public $actsAs = array('Containable', 'Sluggable');

    public $validate = array(
        'title' => array(
            'required' => array(
                'rule' => 'notBlank',
                'message' => 'Title is required',
            ),
            'between' => array(
                'rule' => array('between', 5, 255),
                'message' => 'Title must be 5-255 chars',
            ),
        ),
        'body' => array(
            'rule' => 'notBlank',
        ),
    );

    // Callbacks
    public function beforeSave($options = array())
    {
        return true;
    }

    public function afterFind($results, $primary = false)
    {
        return $results;
    }
}

Find Types & Query Methods

$this->Article->id = 1;

// Standard find types
$all = $this->Article->find('all');
$first = $this->Article->find('first', array(
    'conditions' => array('Article.id' => 1),
));
$count = $this->Article->find('count');
$list = $this->Article->find('list', array(
    'fields' => array('id', 'title'),
));
$threaded = $this->Article->find('threaded');
$neighbors = $this->Article->find('neighbors', array(
    'field' => 'id', 'value' => 5,
));

// Conditions
$recent = $this->Article->find('all', array(
    'conditions' => array(
        'Article.created >=' => date('Y-m-d', strtotime('-7 days')),
        'Article.published' => true,
    ),
    'order' => array('Article.created' => 'DESC'),
    'limit' => 20,
));

// Containable (eager loading)
$this->Article->contain('Author', 'Tag');
$article = $this->Article->findById(1);

// Pagination
$this->paginate = array(
    'contain' => array('Author'),
    'limit' => 20,
    'order' => array('Article.created' => 'desc'),
);
$paginated = $this->paginate('Article');

// Save / Delete
$this->Article->create();
$this->Article->save($data);
$this->Article->delete($id);

Associations

CakePHP 2.x supports 4 association types declared as class properties.

$belongsTo
// articles.author_id -> users.id
public $belongsTo = array(
    'Author' => array(
        'className' => 'User',
        'foreignKey' => 'author_id',
    ),
);
// $article['Author']['name']
$hasMany
// articles.id -> comments.article_id
public $hasMany = array(
    'Comment' => array(
        'className' => 'Comment',
        'foreignKey' => 'article_id',
        'dependent' => true,
    ),
);
// $article['Comment'][0]['body']
$hasOne
// users.id -> profiles.user_id
public $hasOne = array(
    'Profile' => array(
        'className' => 'Profile',
        'foreignKey' => 'user_id',
    ),
);
// $user['Profile']['avatar']
$hasAndBelongsToMany
// articles_tags (pivot table)
public $hasAndBelongsToMany = array(
    'Tag' => array(
        'className' => 'Tag',
        'joinTable' => 'articles_tags',
        'foreignKey' => 'article_id',
        'associationForeignKey' => 'tag_id',
    ),
);
// $article['Tag'][0]['name']

Behaviors

$actsAs — Behavior Usage
// Containable - controls recursive/eager loading
public $actsAs = array('Containable');
$this->Article->contain('Author', 'Tag');
$this->Article->find('all');

// Tree - hierarchical data (MPTT)
public $actsAs = array('Tree');
$this->Article->children($id);
$this->Article->getPath($id);

// Translate - i18n fields
public $actsAs = array(
    'Translate' => array(
        'title' => 'titleTranslation',
        'body' => 'bodyTranslation',
    ),
);

// Timestamp (built-in)
// CakePHP 2.x auto-handles created/modified if columns exist

// Sluggable
public $actsAs = array(
    'Sluggable' => array(
        'field' => 'title',
        'slug' => 'slug',
    ),
);

Views & Helpers

CakePHP 2.x uses .ctp (CakePHP Template) files.

Layout — default.ctp
<!-- app/View/Layouts/default.ctp -->
<!DOCTYPE html>

    <title><?php echo $title_for_layout; ?></title>
    <?php
        echo $this->Html->css('cake.generic');
        echo $this->fetch('meta');

        echo $this->fetch('script');
    ?>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="container">
        <div id="header">

            <?php echo $this->Session->flash(); ?>
            <?php echo $this->fetch('content'); ?>
        </div>

Components

Built-in Components
// app/Controller/AppController.php
class AppController extends Controller
{
    public $components = array(
        'Session',
        'Auth' => array(
            'loginAction' => array('controller' => 'users', 'action' => 'login'),
            'logoutRedirect' => array('controller' => 'users', 'action' => 'login'),
            'authenticate' => array('Form' => array(
                'fields' => array('username' => 'email'),
            )),
        ),
        'Paginator',
        'Cookie',
        'RequestHandler',
        'Security',
        'Acl',
        'Flash',    // NEW in 2.7+, replaced Session::setFlash()
    );
}

// Using components in a controller
$this->Session->setFlash('Message', 'flash', array(), 'success');
$this->Cookie->write('key', 'value', true, '1 day');
$this->RequestHandler->isAjax();
$this->Security->requireSecure();

Authentication & ACL

AuthComponent

UsersController — Login / Logout
// app/Controller/UsersController.php
class UsersController extends AppController
{
    public $name = 'Users';
    public $uses = array('User');

    public function beforeFilter()
    {
        parent::beforeFilter();
        $this->Auth->allow('login', 'logout', 'register');
    }

    public function login()
    {
        if ($this->request->is('post')) {
            if ($this->Auth->login()) {
                return $this->redirect($this->Auth->redirectUrl());
            }
            $this->Session->setFlash('Invalid credentials');
        }
    }

    public function logout()
    {
        return $this->redirect($this->Auth->logout());
    }

    public function register()
    {
        if ($this->request->is('post')) {
            $this->User->create();
            if ($this->User->save($this->request->data)) {
                $this->Session->setFlash('Registration complete');
                return $this->redirect(array('action' => 'login'));
            }
            $this->Session->setFlash('Registration failed');
        }
    }
}

// In AppController:
public $components = array(
    'Auth' => array(
        'loginRedirect' => array('controller' => 'articles', 'action' => 'index'),
        'logoutRedirect' => array('controller' => 'users', 'action' => 'login'),
        'authError' => 'You must login to access this page.',
        'authorize' => array('Controller'),
    ),
);

public function isAuthorized($user = null)
{
    // Default: deny
    return false;
}

ACL Shell

Access Control List
# Create ACL database tables (using SQL file in app/Config/acl.ini.php)

# Initialize ACL
Console/cake acl create aco root
Console/cake acl create aro root

# Create ACO nodes
Console/cake acl create aco root 'Articles'
Console/cake acl create aco Articles 'index'
Console/cake acl create aco Articles 'add'
Console/cake acl create aco Articles 'edit'
Console/cake acl create aco Articles 'delete'

# Create ARO nodes
Console/cake acl create aro root 'Registered'
Console/cake acl create aro root 'Admin'

# Grant/Deny permissions
Console/cake acl grant Admin Articles
Console/cake acl deny Registered Articles/delete

# Check permission
Console/cake acl check Admin Articles/index
  => true

Queue Plugin dereuromark

For CakePHP 2.x, use dereuromark/cakephp-queue (v2.x branch). It uses Shell Tasks to define jobs and provides a worker shell.

Installation

// For CakePHP 2.x use version ~2.0
composer require dereuromark/cakephp-queue:~2.0

// Or manually download and place in app/Plugin/Queue
// Load in app/Config/bootstrap.php:
CakePlugin::load('Queue');

1. Define a Queue Task

app/Console/Command/Task/SendEmailTask.php
// app/Console/Command/Task/SendEmailTask.php
App::uses('QueueTask', 'Queue.Console/Command/Task');

class SendEmailTask extends QueueTask
{
    public $uses = array('Queue.QueuedJob');

    public function run($data)
    {
        // $data contains the payload passed to createJob()
        $to = $data['to'];
        $subject = $data['subject'];
        $body = $data['body'];

        // Send email
        // $this->Email->to($to)->subject($subject)->send($body);

        // Return true on success
        return true;
    }
}

2. Push a Job onto the Queue

// From a controller or any model:
App::uses('QueuedJob', 'Queue.Model');

public function register()
{
    // ... save user ...

    // Add a job to the queue
    $this->QueuedJob = ClassRegistry::init('Queue.QueuedJob');
    $this->QueuedJob->createJob(
        'SendEmail',                         // Task name
        array(                               // Payload data
            'to' => $user['User']['email'],
            'subject' => 'Welcome!',
            'body' => 'Thank you for registering.',
        ),
        null,                                // Not before (datetime or null)
        'emails'                             // Queue group
    );

    $this->Session->setFlash('Registration successful.');
    $this->redirect(array('action' => 'login'));
}

// With delay (schedule for later):
$notBefore = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime('+5 minutes'));
$this->QueuedJob->createJob('SendEmail', $data, $notBefore);

3. Run the Worker

Queue Worker Shell
# Start the queue worker (processes queued jobs)
Console/cake queue.Queue

# Or with the short alias (after loading plugin)
Console/cake queue

# With options
Console/cake queue.Queue --limit 50 --minutes 60

# Run as a cron job (every minute):
* * * * * cd /path/to/app && Console/cake queue.Queue --limit 10 --quiet

# Options:
#   --limit / -l    Max jobs per run
#   --minutes / -m  Run for max N minutes
#   --quiet / -q    Suppress output
#   --force         Run even if already running

4. Managing the Queue

// View queue status from the database
// The plugin creates a queued_jobs table

// Key columns:
// - job_type: Task name (e.g., "SendEmail")
// - data: Serialized payload
// - created: When the job was queued
// - notbefore: Scheduled time (null = immediate)
// - fetched: When worker picked it up
// - completed: When job finished (null = pending)
// - progress: Progress percentage (0-100)
// - failed: Number of failed attempts
// - status: Current status

// Retry logic is automatic:
// - Failed jobs are retried up to 3 times
// - After max retries, job is marked as failed
// - Manual requeue is possible via database

Shell Helpers NEW in 2.8.0

CakePHP 2.8 introduced Shell Helpers (backported from 3.x) for formatting CLI output.

// Available built-in helpers:
// - TableHelper: Display data as a formatted table
// - ProgressHelper: Show a progress bar

// TableHelper usage:
$this->helper('Table')->output($data);

// With headers:
$data = array(
    array('Id', 'Title', 'Created'),
    array(1, 'Hello', '2016-01-01'),
    array(2, 'World', '2016-01-02'),
);
$this->helper('Table')->output($data);

// Output:
// +----+---------+------------+
// | Id | Title   | Created    |
// +----+---------+------------+
// | 1  | Hello   | 2016-01-01 |
// | 2  | World   | 2016-01-02 |
// +----+---------+------------+

// ProgressHelper usage:
$progress = $this->helper('Progress');
$progress->increment(10);
$progress->draw();

// Custom Shell Helper:
// app/Console/Helper/HeadingHelper.php
App::uses('BaseShellHelper', 'Console/Helper');
class HeadingHelper extends BaseShellHelper
{
    public function output($args)
    {
        $args += array('', '#', 3);
        $marker = str_repeat($args[1], $args[2]);
        $this->_consoleOutput->out(
            $marker . ' ' . $args[0] . ' ' . $marker
        );
    }
}

// Usage in shell:
$this->helper('Heading')->output('It works!', '=', 5);

Dispatcher Filters

CakePHP 2.x uses Dispatcher Filters (similar to middleware). Configure in app/Config/bootstrap.php.

// app/Config/bootstrap.php

// Enable cache filter
Configure::write('Dispatcher.filters', array(
    'CacheDispatcher',
    'AssetDispatcher',
));

// Custom filter
// app/Lib/Routing/Filter/MyFilter.php
App::uses('DispatcherFilter', 'Routing');

class MyFilter extends DispatcherFilter
{
    public function beforeDispatch(CakeEvent $event)
    {
        $request = $event->data['request'];
        // Modify request before routing
        return;
    }

    public function afterDispatch(CakeEvent $event)
    {
        $response = $event->data['response'];
        // Modify response after dispatch
        return;
    }
}

// Register in bootstrap.php:
Configure::write('Dispatcher.filters', array(
    'CacheDispatcher',
    'AssetDispatcher',
    'MyFilter',
));

Testing

CakePHP 2.x uses PHPUnit. Tests live in app/Test/. Run via Console/cake testsuite.

Model Test & Fixture
// app/Test/Fixture/ArticleFixture.php
class ArticleFixture extends CakeTestFixture
{
    public $name = 'Article';
    public $import = array('table' => 'articles', 'records' => true);
    public $records = array(
        array(
            'id' => 1,
            'title' => 'Test Article',
            'body' => 'Test body',
            'author_id' => 1,
            'created' => '2016-01-01 00:00:00',
            'modified' => '2016-01-01 00:00:00',
        ),
    );
}

// app/Test/Case/Model/ArticleTest.php
class ArticleTest extends CakeTestCase
{
    public $fixtures = array('app.article');

    public function setUp()
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->Article = ClassRegistry::init('Article');
    }

    public function testFindById()
    {
        $result = $this->Article->findById(1);
        $this->assertEquals('Test Article', $result['Article']['title']);
    }

    public function testValidation()
    {
        $this->Article->create();
        $saved = $this->Article->save(array('Article' => array('body' => '')));
        $this->assertFalse($saved);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($this->Article->validationErrors);
    }
}

Best Practices

Naming Conventions (CakePHP 2.x) — Database tables: plural snake_case (articles). Model classes: singular PascalCase (Article). Controller classes: plural PascalCase (ArticlesController). View files: snake_case (index.ctp). Foreign keys: singular snake_case (author_id). Join tables: alphabetical (articles_tags). Primary key: always id. Created/Modified: auto-tracked as datetime fields.
Key Guidelines
  • Use h() for all output
  • Use Containable for eager loading
  • Never set $recursive > 0 globally
  • Use $actsAs = array('Containable') everywhere
  • Always use $this->Session->setFlash() or Flash component
  • Keep debug off in production
  • Use Sanitize for user input
  • Disable debug mode in production
